content:
The **Bone Hammer** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A large two-handed Scorchbeast bone used as a slow-swinging hammer. [1] It is covered in crystals and deals +50% damage to limbs. It can be repaired with Bone Shards but cannot be modified at a Weapons Workbench.

- Can be sold by the Raider Vendor Bots at Pleasant Valley Station, R&G Station, Sunnytop Station, Sutton Station, Raiders Vendor inside The Whitespring Resort, as well as Vendor Bot Resin inside Pleasant Valley Ski Resort.
- Can be obtained as a quest reward from Daily: Retirement Plan.

1. ↑ Mesh: *ScorchbeastHammer.nif*
